title: Flattening Strategies in Depth: mergeAll, concatAll, switchAll, exhaustAll

options.text: mergeMap(fn) is equivalent to map(fn) followed by mergeAll()
mergeMap(fn) is equivalent to mergeAll() followed by map(fn)
mergeMap(fn) is equivalent to map(fn) followed by concatAll()
mergeMap(fn) has no relationship to mergeAll

questions.explanation: Each *Map operator is map (to produce inner Observables) plus the matching *All (to flatten). So mergeMap = map + mergeAll, switchMap = map + switchAll, etc.

questions.prompt: What must the source of a `mergeAll()` emit?

options.text: Other Observables — it flattens a higher-order Observable
Plain numbers or strings
A single Promise
DOM events

questions.explanation: The *All operators flatten Observable<Observable<T>>. They subscribe to inner Observables and merge their values; feeding them plain values throws.

questions.prompt: How do you cap `mergeMap` at 3 concurrent inner subscriptions?

options.text: Pass a concurrency argument: mergeMap(fn, 3)
Wrap it in take(3)
Use switchMap instead
It is not possible to limit concurrency

questions.explanation: mergeMap(fn, concurrent) and mergeAll(concurrent) bound the number of simultaneously active inners; extra inners queue. Default is Infinity.

questions.prompt: `concatAll()` is equivalent to which mergeAll configuration?

options.text: mergeAll(1) — concurrency of one, strictly sequential
mergeAll(Infinity)
mergeAll(0)
switchAll()

questions.explanation: concatAll runs one inner at a time in order — exactly mergeAll with a concurrency limit of 1.

questions.prompt: The operator `exhaust()` is deprecated. Type the current operator name that replaces it.
questions.explanation: exhaust() was renamed to exhaustAll() in RxJS 7. It ignores new inner Observables while one is still active.

questions.prompt: When is a `*All` operator (rather than a `*Map`) the natural choice?

options.text: When you already hold a higher-order Observable and just need to flatten it
When you need to transform each value but not flatten
When the source emits plain values you want to map
Never — *All operators are deprecated

questions.explanation: Use a *All operator when the source is already Observable<Observable<T>> (e.g., a Subject of Observables). Use a *Map when you map values to inner Observables in one step.
